label: The work window: when it opens, how often it looks, how it estimates
description_nl: core/static/ui.js workWindow reads these (served with the words): download_show_ms / busy_show_ms = how long a download or a button's action runs before the window opens (a quick one never opens it); poll_ms = how often a followed job is asked; tick_ms = the clock; close_done_ms / close_busy_ms = how long a finished download / action stays on screen; pace_after_pct = from this % done the remaining time follows the pace so far instead of the given estimate; cost_pace_after_pct = from this % a missing cost total is projected from the pace; rate_after_s = seconds of bytes before a download speed is trusted.
weight_basis: Owner 2026-09-24: 'only chips and ops for all' - the progress window's numbers are here, not in JavaScript.
